03 · The Sahyadris

Pune within the hour. Mumbai by the expressway.

Casa Brio sits on Tungarli Hill Road, near Tungarli Lake, nestled beneath the Sahyadri mountains. Both cities are an easy drive along the Mumbai–Pune Expressway, and once the gates close the estate is entirely your own.

Gourmet Welcome by Your Private Chef

Day 1 · 2:00 PM · ARRIVAL & WELCOME LUNCH

Estate Check-in & Gourmet Welcome Meal

Arrive at your exclusive private villa in Lonavala at 2:00 PM. Step into the air-conditioned living salon where refreshing welcome drinks await, followed by a multi-course lunch prepared by your private chef.

Day 1 · 4:00 PM · AFTERNOON RECREATION

Sapphire Pool Dip & Box Turf Cricket Matches

Cool off in the crystal sapphire pool under the wooden pergola or challenge your crew to high-stakes box cricket on the private turf inside your grounds.

Day 1 · 8:30 PM · SUNDOWNERS & LATE NIGHTS

Chef's Barbecue & Subterranean REVEL Speakeasy

As dusk falls over Tungarli Lake, gather around the glowing pool for live barbecue grills before heading underground into REVEL for snooker, music, and bar service with zero curfews.

Day 2 · 8:30 AM · MORNING TRANQUILITY

Sahyadri Morning Mist & Artisanal Lawn Breakfast

Wake to mountain mist floating across your bedroom glass. Enjoy freshly brewed artisanal coffee and hot breakfast served alfresco on the garden terrace.

Day 2 · 11:00 AM · FOND FAREWELLS

Unhurried Morning Check-Out

Pack at your leisure, take group photographs by the illuminated pergola deck, and depart refreshed with memories of a private estate entirely your own.
